hook: A century‑old physics trick maps every joint with three sensors.

sections.voiceover: Engineers at Friedrich‑Alexander University Erlangen‑Nürnberg used a theorem with IMUs to locate joint centers in 2026. Each IMU holds three sensors—accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer—measuring motion. How many sensor types—three—enable this mapping?
The 2016 study on this method has been cited 23 times, showing rapid adoption.
2026 Engineering paper proved the method pinpoints joint centers across the body. Three‑sensor IMUs achieved sub‑centimeter accuracy for each joint.
Three sensors unlock full‑body joint mapping in real time.
